name: vali-desktop
description: Vali, your errand butler in Finland

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vali listens while you hold the talk shortcut or press the microphone, so you can say your errand.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Vali reads the title and address of the browser tab in front, and copies the text you select when you press Ask Vali about this.
